title: THE FINALE: Race for the House Cup

steps.clueRiddle:
Run back through everywhere you have raced today.
Bring one treasure home from every leg.
steps.clueReveal: Run one lap through the whole race. Collect one thing from each leg's room. Bring them all back to the living room.

challenges.title: The Memory Lap
challenges.instructions: Visit every room you raced in today. Collect each item on the list. Line them up like trophies when you are done.
checklist: A spoon from the kitchen leg
A leaf or rock from the backyard
One folded sock pair from upstairs
The comfiest cushion from the Couch 500
challenges.photoPrompt: Your trophy collection, all lined up!

steps.funFact: Every Amazing Race finale makes teams remember the whole season.

steps.clueRiddle:
Who remembers every twist of the day?
Five questions stand in the champion's way.
steps.clueReveal: Who remembers it all? Answer five questions about TODAY'S race. You lived every answer!

challenges.title: The Recap Round
challenges.instructions: Five questions about your race today. No hints, no help. Prove you remember it all!

trivia.q: Where did you taste the three mystery bites?
trivia.funFact: Leg 1, with your eyes closed the whole time.

trivia.q: How many sock pairs did the Sock Ninja have to match?
trivia.funFact: Eight pairs in under three minutes. Ninja work.

trivia.q: What did you order at Café Français?
trivia.funFact: Un biscuit, s'il vous plaît — one cookie, please.

trivia.q: Which team was eliminated FIRST this season?
trivia.funFact: They got lost between the kitchen and the backyard.

trivia.q: Which team are you racing in this finale?
trivia.funFact: The rematch of last summer's photo finish!

steps.funFact: Champions win finales with their memory as much as their feet.

steps.clueRiddle:
One year ago you ran this very race.
Beat sixty seconds — and beat your old pace!
steps.clueReveal: The very first challenge you ever did — again! Run two laps around the house or yard. Beat sixty seconds one more time.

challenges.title: Double Lap Dash: The Rematch
challenges.instructions: Tap start, then run two full laps. You have trained a whole year for this. Beat sixty seconds!

steps.funFact: This was the first challenge of your racing career. Full circle!

steps.clueRiddle:
One last puzzle guards the finish line.
Your own photos hold the answer.
steps.clueReveal: Almost there! Play one last game about today's race. Match every photo to its stop, in order.

challenges.title: Photo Finish
challenges.instructions: Look at the photos from today's race. Match each one to its stop. Put them in the right order!

steps.funFact: Press and hold any photo to see it big.

steps.clueRiddle:
Out the front door, fast as you dare.
The finish line mat is waiting there!
steps.clueReveal: This is it. Run out the front door to the driveway. The finish line mat decides EVERYTHING.
steps.funFact: Two teams. One mat. One House Cup.
